name: Optimized FCC Data Fetching
definition: A branchless, lookup-table-free algorithm to determine the tetrahedral polynomial type and fetch 19 FCC data samples for isosurface raycasting, optimizing GPU performance by minimizing conditional branches and memory lookups.
summary: Optimized FCC Data Fetching is a branchless, lookup-table-free algorithm for Box-Spline isosurface raycasting on FCC lattices that minimizes coordinate jumps between adjacent stencils to achieve significant performance gains.
